PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the Gateway transport limit. Reduce the request size or use bulk upsert when supported.

BadGateway.description: Unexpected downstream failure. A failed write response may leave its outcome uncertain.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Transient catalog or storage dependency failure. Use bounded retries where the operation permits.

GatewayTimeout.description: Gateway request deadline exceeded. A write may have been applied; verify its outcome before retrying.

CatalogConflict.description: Conditional catalog conflict. Refresh the resource state before deciding whether to retry.

managedEmbedding.description: Set to false or omit for unmanaged vector fields.

oneOf.description: Types that do not need additional parameters.

FieldsSelector.description: An object to specify a list of field names to include and/or exclude in the result.

include.description: List of field names to include in the result.

exclude.description: List of field names to exclude in the result.

tags.description: Collection metadata tags. Up to five entries.

numPartitions.description: Total number of partitions including the default partition.

numDocs.description: Document count in the default main branch's committed head, not a sum across branches or the count of a selected ref.

snapshotRetentionInDays.description: Number of days to retain committed snapshots.

createdAt.description: Collection creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

updatedAt.description: Collection last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

dataUpdatedAt.description: Default main branch head commit time as Unix epoch milliseconds. Absent before a committed head exists.

ConsistentRead.title: ConsistentRead
ConsistentRead.description: Overlay eligible pending writes on a directly selected branch's committed data. Defaults to false. Tag and alias reads reject true. Pending bulk imports are excluded. Returns 429 if the pending payload exceeds the consistent-read limit.

IncludeVectors.title: IncludeVectors
IncludeVectors.description: If your application need to include vector values in the response, set includeVectors to true.

get.description: Request required info to upload documents. Bulk upsert is not supported for collections with managed embedding vector fields. Upload with the returned method, type as Content-Type, and signed headers. PUT is create-only: reusing an uploaded object can return object-storage 412. Get a new URL for a new upload attempt and resolve uncertain prior outcomes before resubmitting. The object key is bound to the original branch identity and cannot be reused after branch recreation.
